title: How Harness, Loop & Graph Engineering Actually Work (Every AI failure is one of these three things)
description:
Most people building with AI agents have never once counted what their setup can actually reach — and the control room on my own machine proved it by reading a copy of itself out of the trash. Nobody's tooling warned me. Nothing you're running right now will tell you either.

In this video I break down the three decisions that get made every time AI does a real job for you — Harness, Loop, and Graph — and hand you the fixed diagnostic order that replaced my whole afternoon of guessing with a five-minute walkthrough. One of them has no older version of itself anywhere in computing, and it's the one almost everyone skips.

If you're a non-technical founder running AI agents on real work, this is the framework that tells you which of the three is broken on your setup right now — and it starts with an audit you can run this afternoon.
